text:
sarah: Quick postmortem follow-up from the token-validation outage earlier. Goal: close action items this sprint and add recurring checks.
sarah: TL;DR pattern: token TTL drift + gaps in audit logging caused the silent failure. We need explicit ownership and automated detection.
sarah: Proposed tracks:
- token validation hardening
- audit logging coverage + queries
- secrets rotation automation + perms
sarah: Action items (owners + rough ETA):
- raj -> automated TTL checker + alert (due 2026-04-02)
- linda -> service-account rotation in infra pipeline (due 2026-04-09)
- michael -> e2e regression test in CI for token validation (due 2026-04-05)
- security-eng -> runbook + SOC audit query (due 2026-04-03)

raj: I can take the TTL checker. Will drop a PR tomorrow and wire alert to #eng-oncall.

raj: quick snippet I'll use:
```
# cron job: check token expiries
python tools/check_token_ttl.py --env prod --threshold 600
```

linda: I'll own rotation automation. Need vault write perms for the infra bot, @sarah can you confirm? :thumbsup:

sarah: @linda yep added you to vault-admins invite. Also created issue: https://redwood-internal/issue/1234 — contains current manual steps.

michael: I'll add the e2e test. Question: run on every PR or nightly? leaning nightly to avoid CI flakiness.

security-eng: We'll draft runbook and the baseline audit-logging query for SOC ingestion. Will post draft by Friday.

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: Weekly remediation sync every Wed 09:30 PT starting 2026-04-01

sarah: Can we add a recurring 30min calendar invite for owners? I'll create and mark optional.

raj: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/789 — TTL checker + alert rule. PTAL.

linda: Draft infra change for rotation: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/790 — wiring in rotation job and audit step. needs review.

michael: e2e test branch: https://github.com/redwood/services/pull/456 — failing on mock timing, fixing tomorrow.

sarah: Thanks all. I'll update the postmortem doc with owners + deadlines and convert the remediation list into tracked tasks in the tracker. If anything slips, ping me directly. :white_check_mark:

sarah: Also note: recurring incident pattern flagged — similar TTL drift seen twice in last 6 months. Recommend adding an SLO for token validation success rate and adding it to weekly ops dashboard.

security-eng: Agreed on SLO. We'll propose metrics and thresholds in the runbook draft.

michael: added a small TODO to the PR to mock clock advance in the e2e to catch TTL edge cases.

linda: I'll schedule a pairing session with infra reviewers after the PR is up for review.

sarah: Closing note: owners should post a short status update in this thread when they mark their item closed so we can close the loop on the postmortem. Thanks everyone.
